key_insight: On GSM8K, RL recovered accuracy after severely corrupted supervised fine-tuning, suggesting that SFT can supply reasoning format while RL learns effective reasoning.
engineering_relevance: Minimal, even incorrect, format-setting traces may provide a useful RL initialization without requiring extensive gold reasoning demonstrations.
method: Tested 361 SFT corruption configurations varying error type, location, trace–answer consistency, and corruption ratio up to 100%.
Applied Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) after SFT and compared mathematical reasoning accuracy.
Evaluated initialization with just eight incorrect, three-line “form-only” traces.
evidence_signal: SFT-only accuracy fell from 43.61% to 13.80% under corruption, while GRPO generally restored roughly 60%; eight form-only traces yielded 69.30%, versus 60.71% with gold SFT and 35.00% without SFT.
watch_item: The reported evidence is from GSM8K; transfer to other tasks, model scales, and reward settings remains unestablished by the abstract.
paper_title: Reinforcement Learning Unlearns Corrupted SFT Reasoning
